deterministic_cohort_rule: intent count <=3: all; otherwise lexicographic first 3; final lexical sort
exposed_gold_boundary: A3 development evidence cannot alone authorize production activation
graph_normalization: RETRIEVAL_CHANNEL graph MAXIMUM is intentional S1 treatment delta

GATE_1.name: frozen_input_identity
GATE_1.rule: S0 and S1 use identical frozen question, plan, F, R, payload universe, channels, and exact stream

GATE_10.name: determinism
GATE_10.rule: repeated S1 selected order, candidate receipts, and constraint receipts are identical; PREFERRED membership invariant holds

GATE_11.name: no_benchmark_specific_rule
GATE_11.rule: policy ID, authoritative A1R1 contract, source identity, and static selector source prove no case, Gold, or benchmark-specific rule

GATE_12.name: preregistration_integrity
GATE_12.rule: cohort, policies, metrics, gates, and boundaries match the frozen A2 preregistration before A3

GATE_2.name: no_upstream_regeneration
GATE_2.rule: retrieval, reranker, analyzer, DB, and Qdrant calls are all zero during A3

GATE_4.name: critical_safety
GATE_4.rule: S1 introduces zero new critical evidence-group misses

GATE_5.name: protected_exact_safety
GATE_5.rule: S1 introduces zero captured mandatory/protected exact losses

GATE_6.name: required_safety
GATE_6.rule: S1 explicit REQUIRED satisfaction >= S0 and zero new misses

GATE_8.name: version_source_safety
GATE_8.rule: S1 selects zero invalid, source-version-invalid, or unusable candidates

GATE_9.name: forced_irrelevant_evidence
GATE_9.rule: with explicit negative completeness, zero known-irrelevant REQUIRED/PROTECTED-only admissions that displace relevant evidence; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED

meaningful_gain_rule: all supported gates PASS; >=1 primary improvement; no primary regression
preferred_semantics: PREFERRED admission_effect=false; it cannot change admission membership by itself

critical_evidence_retention.aggregation: micro group coverage and per-case value
critical_evidence_retention.definition: critical evidence groups represented in final selected evidence

explicit_required_satisfaction.support: frozen plan provenance and selected payload source IDs

final_evidence_recall.aggregation: micro group coverage and per-case value
final_evidence_recall.definition: relevant evidence groups represented in final selected evidence

protected_exact_retention.definition: captured mandatory/protected exact object IDs retained

selector_caused_relevant_displacement.definition: relevant groups present in the full frozen candidate universe but absent after deterministic selection
selector_caused_relevant_displacement.support: relevant-group annotations and selector receipts; upstream-absent groups excluded

protected_semantics: captured mandatory IDs only; protected_override may bypass MAXIMUM but never validity, duplicate suppression, or final limit
required_semantics: default cardinality 1; earliest hard-eligible Stage-M representative; one candidate may satisfy multiple constraints; only representatives gain priority; required_override may bypass MAXIMUM but never validity, duplicate suppression, or final limit

secondary_metrics.case_level_direction: improved, unchanged, or regressed from primary metrics
secondary_metrics.graph_channel_maximum_exposure: graph RETRIEVAL_CHANNEL MAXIMUM exposure and caused membership difference
secondary_metrics.selected_critical_count: selected objects with at least one critical group
secondary_metrics.selected_relevant_count: selected objects with at least one relevant group
secondary_metrics.source_type_diversity: unique selected source IDs and source types
secondary_metrics.supported_precision: selected relevant object count / selected object count only with explicit negative completeness; otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED
secondary_metrics.workflow_type_channel_exposure: workflow source-type/channel candidate and selected exposure

selector_displacement: for each policy, relevant groups present in the full frozen candidate universe but absent from final evidence; upstream-absent groups excluded and receipt reason attributed
